info.name: Apache Shiro 1.2.4 Cookie RememberME - Deserial Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
author: iamnoooob
rootxharsh
pdresearch
info.description: Apache Shiro before 1.2.5, when a cipher key has not been configured for the "remember me" feature, allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code or bypass intended access restrictions via an unspecified request parameter.
info.remediation: Upgrade to a patched version of Apache Shiro
